IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'PRODUCT_CCD') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.PRODUCT_CCD;
END;

WITH FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION 
AS(
    SELECT DISTINCT A.* FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication A
	JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId,FcbsApplicationId, SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication GROUP BY FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, FcbsApplicationId, SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.FinancialProductId = B.FinancialProductId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode AND A.FcbsApplicationId = B.FcbsApplicationId  AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
    WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)

, PRODUCT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.Dimproduct
)

SELECT 
     ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM Product_SK) AS ProductSK, * 
     INTO DW.PRODUCT_CCD
     FROM(
        SELECT DISTINCT
    BFP.FinancialProductId AS ProductID
    ,BFP.FinancialProductName AS ProductName
    ,BFPG.ProductGrouping AS ProductGroup
    ,NULL AS ProductDescription
    ,BFPA.FcbsApplicationId AS FcbsApplication
    ,DB.BankSk AS BankSK
    ,Null AS BranchSK
    ,1 AS CurrentIndicator
    ,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
    ,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
    ,BFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode 
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm

FROM BNKM.FinancialProduct BFP
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FINANCIALPRODUCTGROUPING BFPG ON BFP.FINANCIALPRODUCTID = BFPG.FINANCIALPRODUCTID AND BFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BFPG.FinancialInstitutionId AND BFP.SourceSystemCode = BFPG.SourceCode
LEFT JOIN FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION BFPA ON BFP.FINANCIALPRODUCTID = BFPA.FINANCIALPRODUCTID AND BFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BFPA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BFPA.SourceSystemCode = BFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DB ON BFP.FinancialInstitutionId = DB.BANKID
WHERE BFP.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)A

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA_CCD') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA_CCD;
END;

WITH
TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     convert(varchar,ProductID)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductName)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductGroup)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductDescription)
    ,convert(varchar,FcbsApplication)
    ,convert(INT,BankSK)
    ,convert(INT,BranchSK)
    )) HASHROW, ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.PRODUCT_CCD
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     convert(varchar,ProductID)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductName)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductGroup)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductDescription)
    ,convert(varchar,FcbsApplication)
    ,convert(INT,BankSK)
    ,convert(INT,BranchSK)
    )) HASHROW, ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.Dimproduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)

    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.ProductID,TGT.ProductID) AS ProductID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.ProductID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
INTO DW.TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA_CCD	
FROM TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.ProductID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL)

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, @DatetoProcessed))
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.Dimproduct TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA_CCD DELTA ON DELTA.ProductID = TGT.ProductID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.PRODUCT_CCD SRC ON SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD';

     ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM Product_SK) AS ProductSK,* 
     INTO DW.PRODUCT_TRY
     FROM(
        SELECT DISTINCT
    BFP.FinancialProductId AS ProductID
    ,BFP.FinancialProductName AS ProductName
    ,BFPG.ProductGrouping AS ProductGroup
    ,NULL AS ProductDescription
    ,BFPA.FcbsApplicationId AS FcbsApplication
    ,DB.BankSk AS BankSK
    ,Null AS BranchSK
    ,1 AS CurrentIndicator
    ,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
    ,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
    ,BFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode 
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm

FROM BNKM.FinancialProduct BFP
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FINANCIALPRODUCTGROUPING BFPG ON BFP.FINANCIALPRODUCTID = BFPG.FINANCIALPRODUCTID AND BFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BFPG.FinancialInstitutionId AND BFP.SourceSystemCode = BFPG.SourceCode
LEFT JOIN FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION BFPA ON BFP.FINANCIALPRODUCTID = BFPA.FINANCIALPRODUCTID AND BFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BFPA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BFPA.SourceSystemCode = BFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DB ON BFP.FinancialInstitutionId = DB.BANKID

)A

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA_TRY') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA_TRY;
END;

WITH
TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     convert(varchar,ProductID)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductName)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductGroup)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductDescription)
    ,convert(varchar,FcbsApplication)
    ,convert(INT,BankSK)
    ,convert(INT,BranchSK)
    )) HASHROW, ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.PRODUCT_TRY
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     convert(varchar,ProductID)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductName)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductGroup)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductDescription)
    ,convert(varchar,FcbsApplication)
    ,convert(INT,BankSK)
    ,convert(INT,BranchSK)
    )) HASHROW, ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.Dimproduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'
)

    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.ProductID,TGT.ProductID) AS ProductID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.ProductID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
INTO DW.TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA_TRY	
FROM TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.ProductID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL)

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, @DatetoProcessed))
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.Dimproduct TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA_TRY DELTA ON DELTA.ProductID = TGT.ProductID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.PRODUCT_TRY SRC ON SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY';
